note_en: 越来越 + adjective or verb means "more and more": 关注她的人越来越多，品牌寄来的包裹也越来越多 "more and more people followed her, and more and more packages arrived from brands." 越来越 sits right in front of the word that is growing and never changes form. Two of them can be set against each other: 粉丝越来越多，她却越来越不知道… "her followers kept growing, yet she knew less and less…."
